intro.text: Sah is a freed parshman, a singer who joins a group of escaped singers and helps guard Kaladin after capturing him.
Sah is a singer and former parshman, freed when the Everstorm first passed. He was one of Kaladin's captors before being forced to join the Voidbringer forces in the Siege of Kholinar.

items.text: Sah was a household slave at a brightlord's manor a few days from Hearthstone, serving drinks at dinner. His mate was taken from him and sold after she gave birth to their daughter, Vai.

When the Everstorm freed him, Sah escaped with Vai and joined a group of singers led by Khen and guided by a Voidspren. On the way to Revolar they captured Kaladin, and Sah guarded him and talked with him about the enslavement of the singers. Kaladin stayed with the group, teaching them to survive, and became Sah's friend.

After Kaladin left suddenly, Sah's group was blamed for harbouring a spy and put to hard labour, and Vai was taken from him. Moash, also captured, defended them and taught them to fight, since they were to be among the first to assault Kholinar.
At the Siege of Kholinar, Sah's group stormed the palace, where he and Kaladin recognized each other. Sah killed Beard of the Wall Guard with a spear, and was killed by Noro in turn.

appearance.text: Sah is tall, with the marbled skin of a singer and rough hands. After being freed he usually wears workform, with dark, thick red beard strands, and at first the same simple smock he wore as a parshman.

personality.text: He owns a set of cards though he never learned the rules as a parshman, and Vai treats them as a favourite toy.

Sah is gentle and introspective and avoids conflict, though he sometimes bursts out in anger. He wants nothing more than to protect his daughter, and resents humanity for enslaving his people, while also being wary of the Fused and unhappy to fight for them.
